scheme_name: SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship - Uttar Pradesh
description:
The SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship in Uttar Pradesh is a significant welfare initiative aimed at promoting education among students belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST). 

This scholarship scheme was launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh in the year 2007. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to SC and ST students who are studying in classes 9 and 10. 

The scheme aims to reduce the dropout rate among these students by providing them with the necessary financial support to continue their education. 

The government has set a target to cover a substantial number of students under this scheme each academic year. 

In the academic year 2021-2022, the Uttar Pradesh government allocated approximately ₹1,000 crores for the implementation of this scholarship scheme. 

The benefits provided under the SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship include a monthly stipend of ₹1,000 for students studying in class 9 and ₹1,200 for those in class 10. 

Additionally, students are entitled to receive a one-time grant of ₹1,000 for purchasing books and study materials. 

The scholarship also covers the cost of school uniforms and other essential educational expenses. 

Eligibility criteria for the SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship are clearly defined. 

Students must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe communities as recognized by the Government of India. 

They must be enrolled in a government or government-aided school in Uttar Pradesh. 

The annual income of the student's family should not exceed ₹2 lakhs. 

Students must be studying in classes 9 or 10 to qualify for this scholarship. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required apart from being enrolled in the aforementioned classes. 

The application process for the SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship is straightforward and can be completed online. 

Students must visit the official website of the Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department. 

They need to create an account by providing their basic details such as name, date of birth, and contact information. 

Once registered, students can log in to fill out the scholarship application form. 

The application form requires students to provide details such as their caste certificate, income certificate, and school enrollment details. 

Students must upload scanned copies of these documents as part of their application. 

After submitting the application, students should keep track of their application status on the same portal. 

The scholarship is disbursed on a yearly basis. 

Students can expect the scholarship amount to be credited to their bank accounts within three months of the application submission. 

The disbursement schedule may vary slightly each year based on the academic calendar and government regulations. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process, disbursing funds, and ensuring that the scholarship reaches the intended beneficiaries. 

For any queries related to the scholarship, students can contact the Social Welfare Department at their official helpline number, which is 1800 180 5522. 

The department also has regional offices across Uttar Pradesh to assist students in the application process. 

The SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship has significantly impacted the education of SC and ST students in Uttar Pradesh. 

According to reports, the scheme has benefitted over 10 lakh students since its inception. 

The dropout rate among SC and ST students has decreased by approximately 20% since the launch of this scholarship. 

This initiative aligns with the Government of India’s broader efforts to promote education among marginalized communities. 

The scholarship not only provides financial assistance but also encourages students to pursue higher education. 

The government has also introduced awareness campaigns to inform students and parents about the benefits of this scholarship. 

The SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship is part of a larger framework of welfare schemes aimed at uplifting disadvantaged communities in India. 

Other related schemes include the Post Matric Scholarship and the Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for SC/ST students. 

The government continuously reviews and updates the scheme to ensure it meets the needs of the beneficiaries effectively. 

In recent years, there has been an emphasis on digitizing the application process to make it more accessible. 

Students are encouraged to apply as early as possible to avoid last-minute issues with documentation or submission. 

The government has also streamlined the verification process to ensure timely disbursement of funds. 

In addition to financial support, the scholarship aims to instill confidence in SC and ST students regarding their educational pursuits. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries and educational institutions alike. 

Schools are encouraged to assist students in the application process to ensure maximum participation. 

The scholarship is a crucial step towards achieving educational equity in Uttar Pradesh. 

The government aims to expand the reach of this scheme in the coming years to include more beneficiaries. 

The SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship is a testament to the commitment of the Uttar Pradesh government towards inclusive education. 

It reflects the ongoing efforts to empower marginalized communities through education and financial support. 

In conclusion, the SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship in Uttar Pradesh is a vital initiative that provides essential financial assistance to SC and ST students. 

This scheme not only aims to reduce dropout rates but also encourages students to pursue their educational aspirations. 

With a clear application process and defined eligibility criteria, it stands as a beacon of hope for many families in Uttar Pradesh. 

The continuous support from the government ensures that the benefits of this scholarship reach those who need it the most. 

The SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship is an important component of the educational landscape in Uttar Pradesh. 

It plays a significant role in shaping the future of countless students from marginalized backgrounds.
